verdict: ROAS holds strong at 4.74 while local search visibility needs attention.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, your Meta ads returned $4.74 for every $1 spent, generating $6,644.21 in revenue from 37 purchases on $1,401.43 in spend — a solid result. Return on ad spend and purchases dipped slightly week-over-week (down 7.83% and 8.33% respectively), but the most recent three days show purchases recovering, suggesting the dip is stabilising rather than deepening. The more pressing watch is your Google Business Profile, which recorded zero local actions on October 23 and 24 after averaging 19 per day for the previous 25 days — that gap in local visibility is being investigated and addressed now. Website sessions rose 22% week-over-week, so paid and owned traffic remain active; the priority heading into next week is restoring consistent local search presence before it softens top-of-funnel volume.
